summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting that at an adjourned annual meeting, shareholders approved a new advisory agreement after a change of control of the adviser. NXG Cushing, owned by senior employees of the adviser, acquired a 62% interest from founder Jerry V. Swank and replaced Swank Capital as general partner. This triggered assignment of the prior agreement and adoption of a materially identical new one. The board recommended the new agreement; no advisors named. Watch for shareholder litigation or proxy advisor scrutiny; risk-arb angle limited as terms are unchanged and control shifted internally.
